inventory_policy: The web inventories remain model decompositions. Source adjudication found no additional unrepresented substantive relation requiring a new assertion ID, but this does not certify a uniquely correct atomization. Required-content coverage and assertion precision are distinct. Correct local assertions can coexist with a whole-report contradiction defeating a required item.
assertion_granularity_limitation: Report-specific deduplicated relation inventories are not automatically comparable to the independently built side-chat inventories. No kappa is calculated across different inventories.
